attempts.sql: SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS sp JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.file_profile AS fp ON sp.file_id = fp.file_id WHERE fp.is_test = FALSE AND sp.module LIKE 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo%' AND sp.is_public = TRUE GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This counts public symbols (classes, functions, methods) from non-test files in the auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo package. It joins symbol_profile with file_profile on file_id, filters out test files using file_profile.is_test = FALSE, restricts to the kumo module via module LIKE, and groups by symbol kind to produce one row per kind with the public count.
sql: SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS sp JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.file_profile AS fp ON sp.file_id = fp.file_id WHERE fp.is_test = FALSE AND sp.module LIKE 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo%' AND sp.is_public = TRUE GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind
